questionnaire.title: Questionnaire

questions.painWalkingFlat: How much pain do you feel when walking on a flat surface?
questions.painStairs: How much pain do you feel when going up or down stairs?
questions.painNight: How much pain do you feel at night while in bed?
questions.painSittingLying: How much pain do you feel while sitting or lying down?
questions.painStanding: How much pain do you feel while standing upright?
questions.stiffnessMorning: How stiff are your joints right after waking up in the morning?
questions.stiffnessLaterDay: How stiff do your joints get later in the day, after sitting or resting?
questions.functionDownStairs: How much difficulty do you have going down stairs?
questions.functionUpStairs: How much difficulty do you have going up stairs?
questions.functionRising: How much difficulty do you have rising from sitting?
questions.functionStanding: How much difficulty do you have standing?
questions.functionBending: How much difficulty do you have bending to the floor?
questions.functionWalking: How much difficulty do you have walking on flat ground?
questions.functionVehicle: How much difficulty do you have getting in or out of a vehicle?
questions.functionHeavyWork: How much difficulty do you have doing heavy household or farm work?
questions.functionBed: How much difficulty do you have getting in or out of bed?
questions.functionSquatting: How much difficulty do you have squatting?

questionnaire.instruction: Select the response that best describes the patient's current condition.

gait.title: Gait Assessment
gait.subtitle: Knee movement and gait screening
gait.readyDescription: The movement sensor will record walking patterns to identify gait-related risk markers.
gait.fitSensorDescription: Secure the knee sensor correctly before starting.
gait.checkConnectionDescription: The system will establish the sensor connection.
gait.walkNormallyDescription: Maintain your normal walking pace during recording.
gait.sensorReminder: Ensure the sensor is fitted correctly before continuing.
gait.connectingDescription: Establishing a connection with the knee movement sensor. Please remain ready for the assessment.
gait.recordingDescription: Maintain a natural walking pace while the sensor records your movement.
gait.completeDescription: Movement data has been recorded successfully. Preparing the final screening result.
gait.footer: OA Screening System · Gait Movement Assessment

result.title: Screening Result
result.name: Name
result.disclaimer: This screening result is intended to support early risk assessment and does not replace clinical diagnosis.
result.recommendationNone: Continue regular activity and routine monitoring.
result.recommendationLow: Maintain regular physical activity and monitor symptoms.
result.recommendationMild: Consider lifestyle adjustments and follow-up if symptoms persist.
result.recommendationModerate: Consider evaluation by a healthcare professional.
result.recommendationSevere: Referral to a healthcare professional is recommended for further evaluation.
